# hitachi_vsp_nvmes (Data Source)

Datasource to show multiple NVM subsystems info in Hitachi VSP storage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
#
# Hitachi VSP NVM Subsystems Data Retrieval
#
# This section defines a data source block to fetch information about multiple 
# NVM Subsystems from a Hitachi Virtual Storage Platform (VSP) using 
# HashiCorp Configuration Language (HCL).
#
# The data source block "hitachi_vsp_nvmes" retrieves a list of 
# subsystems based on the provided filters. This allows you to discover 
# subsystem IDs, names, and optionally enrich the output with detailed 
# port, host NQN, and namespace/path information.
#
# Provide the storage system serial number and optional filters. 
# You can use the "include_ports", "include_host_nqns", and "include_namespaces" 
# inputs to toggle the retrieval of extended configuration data.
#
# Search Patterns (Optional):
#   1. ID Filter:   [nvm_subsystem_id]   -> Matches a specific ID.
#   2. Name Filter: [nvm_subsystem_name] -> Matches by name (case-insensitive).
#   3. No Filter:   Returns all NVM subsystems for the storage system.
#
# Enrichment Inputs (Boolean):
#   - include_ports:      Fetches associated NVM ports for each subsystem.
#   - include_host_nqns:  Fetches authorized host NQNs and mapping paths.
#   - include_namespaces: Fetches LDEV namespace IDs and their Host NQN paths.
#



#####################
# Example: Fetch All Subsystems (Basic)
# Retrieves basic information for every NVM subsystem on the storage system.
data "hitachi_vsp_nvmes" "all" {
  serial = 12345
}

output "all_subsystems" {
  value = data.hitachi_vsp_nvmes.all.nvm_subsystems
}

output "total_count" {
  value = data.hitachi_vsp_nvmes.all.nvm_subsystem_count
}

#####################
# Example: Full Enrichment by Name
# Finds a specific subsystem and includes namespaces, ports, and host NQNs.
data "hitachi_vsp_nvmes" "enriched" {
  serial             = 12345
  nvm_subsystem_name = "PROD_ESXI_CLUSTER"
  include_namespaces = true
  include_ports      = true
  include_host_nqns  = true
}

output "enriched_subsystems" {
  value = data.hitachi_vsp_nvmes.enriched.nvm_subsystems
}

#####################
# Example: Filter by ID with Path Enrichment
# Retrieves a subsystem by ID and includes host NQN path mappings.
data "hitachi_vsp_nvmes" "filtered_id" {
  serial            = 12345
  nvm_subsystem_id  = 10
  include_host_nqns = true
}

output "subsystem_details" {
  value = data.hitachi_vsp_nvmes.filtered_id.nvm_subsystems
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `serial` (Number) Serial number of the storage system.

### Optional

- `include_host_nqns` (Boolean) If true, include host NQNs and host NQN paths information in the output.
- `include_namespaces` (Boolean) If true, include namespaces information in the output.
- `include_ports` (Boolean) If true, include ports information in the output.
- `nvm_subsystem_id` (Number) Filter by NVM subsystem ID.
- `nvm_subsystem_name` (String) Filter by NVM subsystem name (case-insensitive).
- `nvm_subsystems` (Block List) List of NVMe subsystems matching the filter criteria. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--nvm_subsystems))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nvm_subsystem_count` (Number) Number of NVM subsystems returned.

<a id="nestedblock--nvm_subsystems"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nvm_subsystems`

Optional:

- `namespaces` (Block List) List of namespaces created in the NVM subsystem. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--nvm_subsystems--namespaces))

Read-Only:

- `host_mode` (String) Host mode of the NVM subsystem.
- `host_mode_options` (List of Number) List of host mode option numbers set for the NVM subsystem.
- `host_nqns` (Block List) List of Host NQNs registered to this subsystem. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--nvm_subsystems--host_nqns))
- `namespace_security_setting` (String) Namespace security settings (Enable, Disable, or Unknown).
- `nvm_subsystem_id` (Number) NVM subsystem ID.
- `nvm_subsystem_name` (String) NVM subsystem name.
- `nvm_subsystem_nqn` (String) Subsystem NQN. If virtualized, outputs the virtualized NQN.
- `port_ids` (List of String) List of registered port IDs (e.g., CL1-A).
- `resource_group_id` (Number) Resource group ID of the resource group to which the NVM subsystem belongs.
- `t10_pi_mode` (String) Status of the T10 PI mode of the port (Enable, Disable, or Unknown).
- `virtual_nvm_subsystem_id` (Number) Virtual NVM subsystem ID. Output for VSP 5000 series storage systems.

<a id="nestedblock--nvm_subsystems--namespaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nvm_subsystems.namespaces`

Optional:

- `namespace_nickname` (String) Nickname for the namespace.
- `paths` (List of String) List of Host NQNs that have access to this namespace.

Read-Only:

- `ldev_id` (Number) LDEV number associated with the namespace.
- `ldev_id_hex` (String) LDEV hexadecimal number associated with the namespace.
- `namespace_id` (Number) The Namespace ID.


<a id="nestedblock--nvm_subsystems--host_nqns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nvm_subsystems.host_nqns`

Read-Only:

- `host_nqn` (String) The NVMe Qualified Name (NQN) of the host.
- `host_nqn_id` (String) The unique identifier for the Host NQN.
- `host_nqn_nickname` (String) The nickname assigned to the Host NQN.
